body.heading: Pick your animal
paragraphs: Think of an animal. Do not say its name. Show it with your body: stomp like an elephant or slither like a snake.
Everyone else watches and guesses. Shout the answer when you think you know.

body.heading: Join the parade
paragraphs: When your animal is guessed, join the parade line and keep moving like your animal.
At the end, the whole family is marching, flapping, and hopping together.

takeaway: Your body can become any animal you can imagine.
safetyNotes: Clear a safe space to move; march on carpet or grass if knees will be busy.
screenFreeExtension: Have a sleepy animal parade, where everyone moves in slow motion.
